channel.title: QwesiRED
channel.description: Offensive Security Consultant | AppSec & SecOps Leader

item.title: REA: The Complete Guide to AI-Powered Reverse Engineering
item.description: A deep dive into REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) — the viral open-source toolkit that bridges AI coding agents with binary analysis engines like Ghidra and Hopper.

item.title: CVE-2026-82039: SQL Injection in UTMStack Asset Groups Search
item.description: A time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability in UTMStack allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary SQL queries against PostgreSQL, enabling full database compromise including credential extraction.

item.title: CVE-2026-77927: Blind SQL Injection in ClipBucket V5 Photo Deletion
item.description: Exploiting a sanitizer bypass in ClipBucket V5 to achieve blind SQL injection through the photo deletion endpoint, extracting full database contents including password hashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-77928: Blind SQL Injection in ClipBucket V5 Private Message Deletion
item.description: A blind SQL injection vulnerability in ClipBucket V5 private messaging that enables full database extraction, demonstrated with complete cb_users table dump including password hashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-77929: From Image Upload to Remote Code Execution in ClipBucket V5
item.description: A critical file upload vulnerability in ClipBucket V5 allows any registered user to upload PHP webshells disguised as images, achieving persistent remote code execution on the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-86751: Snipe-IT Arbitrary File Read and SSRF via Acceptance Note Injection
item.description: How I discovered a critical vulnerability in Snipe-IT that allows any authenticated user to read arbitrary server files and perform SSRF attacks through a simple markdown image in an acceptance note.

item.title: CVE-2026-80138: ClipBucket V5 Unauthenticated RCE via Web Installer Command Injection
item.description: How I discovered a critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in ClipBucket V5 web installer that allows complete server compromise with a single HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2026-77915: From Zero to Admin - Unauthenticated Takeover in rConfig Core
item.description: A critical vulnerability allowing complete unauthenticated takeover of rConfig instances through a misconfigured registration route that grants Admin privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-77914: rConfig Core Path Traversal to Full Application Compromise
item.description: How I discovered a critical path traversal vulnerability in rConfig Core that allows any authenticated user to read arbitrary files, including the application secrets.
